messages:
ivy: FYI — large takeout labeled 'Sushi Tour' just dropped at the mailroom. It's for tomorrow's campus tour (11:30). No contact on the label. Do we hand out visitor badges or a temporary sticker stamp? :sushi:

mike: who from Brink Labs is the contact? I can hold the box in locker 3.

ivy: nothing on the label other than 'Brink Labs — samples'. Calendar event 'Campus Tour — External' shows 11:30-12:15.

frontdesk-bot: New visitor pre-reg: 'Brink Labs' x8 at 11:25 — host: @josh

josh: that's the partner tour. host is @olga. They asked for seating for 6 + couch space.

olga: yep. Prefer sticker stamps over lanyards for quick in/out. Also want 2 hot-seat spots in the lounge for demos.

linda: we still have the sticker-stamp kit from last month — orange "VISITOR" stickers. Or we can use wristbands if they look too casual.

tom: sofa dibs poll — where to put them so demo table doesn't get blocked? :thinking_face:

mike: Conference A :one:

olga: Lobby sofa :two:

josh: Demo bar stools :three:

ivy: Plan: lobby sofa + 2 chairs in Conference A as backup. I'll label the box "Tour snacks — do not mix with staff lunch" and place in locker 3. @mike can you set up the sticker station at the front desk at 11:10?

mike: yup. Also a courier left 2 packages for Sara at the desk — small binders. Putting them on her desk now.

linda: I'll badge visitors on arrival. Quick fridge note: if anything needs chilling, mark with `FRIDGE` tag.

ivy: label to print:

```
TOUR SUSHI - FOR CAMPUS TOUR 11:30
LOCKER 3 - FRONT DESK
DO NOT OPEN - PEOPLE OPS
```

mike: tagged locker 3, put a red post-it on it. :white_check_mark:

olga: thanks! Also can someone grab an extra throw blanket? The sofa area gets chilly. :cold_face:

josh: grabbed one from storage locker 2. will drop by 11:15.

ivy: awesome team. quick reminder for hosts: bring guest list on your phone to speed sign-in. :wave:

tom: noted. see you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
